header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
Mr. Muhammad Shareef Solangi, A.A.G a/w Shamsuddin Rathore,
D.E.O (ES&HS) Tharparkar, Jeewan Mansha on behalf of Director
School Education (ES&HS) Mirpurkhas, and Ashfaq Ali, D.E.O
This petition was filed with the prayer that the subject school was
deactivated and not operationalized be activated.
Today, learned A.A.G filed statement including the notification
body: dated 11 November 2026 and as per the notification subject school has now been activated.

Under these circumstances, this petition has become infructuous and is hereby disposed of with directions to official respondents to keep the school operational and provide all the educational facilities to the children of locality.
